obesity_severity.instructions: How severe is the patient's obesity or body habitus limitation documented in the note?
criteria: No obesity or no body-habitus limitation mentioned
Mild obesity or mild body-habitus limitation
Moderate obesity or clearly noted body-habitus limitation
Severe obesity or marked body-habitus limitation that likely affects exposure/positioning

preop_anticoagulation_or_bleeding_risk.instructions: Is there evidence of preoperative anticoagulation/antiplatelet use or another bleeding-risk issue that could prolong hemostasis or require reversal?

criteria.none: No anticoagulation/antiplatelet use or bleeding-risk issue mentioned
criteria.anticoagulation: Patient was taking anticoagulants or antiplatelet agents preoperatively
criteria.coagulopathy: A coagulopathy, thrombocytopenia, or similar bleeding-risk problem is documented
criteria.both: Both anticoagulation/antiplatelet use and a bleeding-risk problem are documented

prior_abdominal_or_pelvic_surgery.instructions: Does the note document prior abdominal or pelvic surgery that could make the operation more difficult?

criteria.true: Prior abdominal or pelvic surgery is documented
criteria.false: No prior abdominal or pelvic surgery is documented

intraoperative_organ_injury_or_unexpecte.instructions: Does the note document an intraoperative injury to an organ/structure or an unexpected anatomic problem that required additional repair or management?

criteria.true: An intraoperative injury, leak, perforation, or unexpected anatomic problem is documented
criteria.false: No such injury or unexpected anatomic problem is documented

case_urgency_or_unplanned_add_on.instructions: What best describes the case urgency or scheduling status?

criteria.add_on_unplanned: Unplanned add-on case or case converted from a different plan
